title: Separate Venus address domains, transfer units and physical memory capacities
human_request: 帮我审核通过后写入，然后继续上面的写dag的任务
accepted_scope: Promote general address-domain and transfer-unit rules to the Venus foundation guide.
Store absolute Venus2 memory addresses only under backend venus2p0-16x128 and RTL bf82d804.
Retain the PBCH FEP combined-image layout as a workload instance rather than a universal layout.
Reject the inferred fixed LDU +0x4000 translation and its -0x4000 workaround.
review_findings: The active RTL configuration allocates 0x80000 bytes (512 KiB) of shared SRAM; 0x4000 is the 16 KiB physical VRF data capacity for this profile.
An i16 vload length of 16384 requests 32768 bytes and wraps the 8192-i16 physical VRF, explaining the apparent 0x4000 displacement.
The descriptor payload offset is proven for LDU/STU use but is not proven as a scalar C pointer in the current Gem5 adapter.
The active wrapper/fabric mapping at 0x80008000 conflicts with older 0x80020000 SoC package constants.

deferred_changes.reason: The approved PBCH golden records the current backend-manifest digest. Mutating it during this active workload would stale that binding; add the authoritative memory map only through a separately frozen backend qualification attempt before RTL.
No positive/negative Gem5 plus RTL probe currently proves a scalar virtual address for descriptor payload offsets.

rollback: Restore the foundation base digest, remove the scoped empirical record, and remove the corresponding live-registry entries.
